lines.speaker: e
lines.text: A dead man's pockets held two notes the F B I still can't read.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: Over thirty lines of letters, numbers, and brackets.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: Ricky muh-KOR-mik was found in a mih-ZOOR-ee cornfield. Cause of death: undetermined.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: F B I codebreakers crack almost every cipher. This one stopped them at step two.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: So in twenty eleven, the bureau asked the public for help.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: But his own family says Ricky could barely write his name.

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: So who wrote the code he carried?

lines.speaker: e
lines.text: A flood of tips later, the case is still open.
